name: Endosome, phagosome and autophagosome fusion with lysosomes
rationale: All members describe delivery of endocytic, phagocytic or autophagic compartments into lysosomes by membrane fusion; unlike the autophagosome-assembly confusables it includes phagosome and endosomal fusion, and unlike the Golgi-lysosome confusable it is about fusion rather than vesicle biogenesis.

core: MET and PTK6 receptor tyrosine kinase signalling
name: MET and PTK6 signalling with endocytic receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover HGF/MET receptor signalling, PTK6 (BRK) signalling and ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB4; the PTK6 and endocytic-downregulation members separate it from ERBB/PI3K confusables, and the MET members from the PTEN/ERBB4 confusable.

name: Insulin receptor–IRS–AKT2 signalling and its attenuation
rationale: All members concern insulin receptor signalling through IRS and AKT2 to glycogen synthesis and glucose uptake, including its negative regulation; confusables instead centre on adiponectin, glucagon or generic PI3K/IGF1R signalling.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ketogenesis
rationale: Members are the stepwise acyl-CoA beta-oxidation reactions, carnitine synthesis and transport, and ketone body synthesis and use; carnitine and ketone body members separate it from the branched-chain amino acid/PDH/TCA and fatty acid transport confusables.

name: Atypical ubiquitin chain assembly and ISG15 antiviral conjugation
rationale: Members cover non-K48/K63 (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched, free) ubiquitin chain formation plus ISG15 conjugation in interferon antiviral defence; the conjugation and ISG15 members separate it from the deubiquitinase confusables and from the viral-replication confusable.

qualifier: from G beta-gamma, BCR and lysophospholipid receptors
name: Lipid second-messenger signalling via G beta-gamma, BCR and lysophospholipid receptors
rationale: Members share generation of PLC/PI3K/PKC lipid and calcium second messengers downstream of G beta-gamma, the B cell receptor, S1P/LPA receptors and VEGFR2; Fc-gamma phagocytosis, CD22 BCR regulation and generic calcium confusables lack the G beta-gamma and lysophospholipid receptor members.

name: Deubiquitinase control of TNFR1 and NF-kappaB signalling
rationale: Members combine TNFR1/NF-kappaB signalling regulation with deubiquitinase families and K48/K63/linear ubiquitin chain control; the deubiquitinase members are what the non-canonical NIK and TLR/IKK confusables lack.

qualifier: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 with ERK1/2 activation
name: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 signalling with ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members are IL-6 and the gp130-using IL-27/IL-35 cytokine pathways with downstream ERK1/2 activation; IL-27/IL-35 separate it from IL-11/CNTF/LIF confusables, and IL-6 and ERK members from the IL-2/IL-12 family confusable.

name: Meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, chiasmata and chromosome segregation
rationale: All members describe the structural events of meiotic chromosome cohesion, chiasma formation, alignment and segregation; confusables are mitotic cohesion or meiotic cell cycle transition control.

name: Pyruvate–oxaloacetate–malate metabolism and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: Members cover TCA-linked dicarboxylate and pyruvate metabolism, pyruvate transport and the malate-aspartate shuttle with aspartate metabolism; confusables are PDH/CoA, electron transport, dicarboxylate transporters or glutamate/alanine metabolism.

name: Peroxide and nitrosative stress responses, BACH1–HMOX1 and apoptosis
rationale: Members are cellular responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxide and nitric oxide, including HMOX1/BACH1 regulation and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis; ROS-detoxification confusables lack the apoptosis and nitrosative members, and ferroptosis/hypoxia confusables lack BACH1–HMOX1.

core: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production
name: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production, cGAMP–STING promotion
rationale: Members concern myeloid dendritic cell cytokine output, CCL5 and STAT6-induced chemokines, and promotion of cGAS/STING signalling via cGAMP import; macrophage chemokine confusables lack the STING and dendritic members, interferon confusables lack the chemokine members.

core: Membrane transport of water and small solutes
qualifier: aquaporin, magnesium, inositol and paracellular routes
name: Aquaporin water, magnesium, inositol and paracellular transport
rationale: Members describe water homeostasis via aquaporins, magnesium and inositol transport, and paracellular/barrier transport; aquaporin and inositol members distinguish it from the tight junction and cation-chloride cotransporter confusables.

qualifier: ABC transporter defects in bile secretion
name: Apical phospholipid translocation and ABC transporter defects
rationale: Members cover phospholipid/sphingolipid flipping, apical and raft protein localisation, bile acid secretion and diseases of the apical ABC transporters ABCB4, ABCB11 and CFTR; the lipid translocation and ABCB members are what the CFTR-trafficking and epithelial secretion confusables lack.

core: BH3-only neutralisation of anti-apoptotic BCL-2 proteins
name: NOXA and PUMA neutralisation of anti-apoptotic BCL-2 proteins
rationale: All members describe BH3-only protein activation and binding to anti-apoptotic BCL-2 members leading to cytochrome c release; NOXA and PUMA distinguish it from the BAD/BIM/BID/BAX/BAK confusables and from p53 transcription confusables.

name: Phospholipid signalling via lysophospholipid receptors and VEGFR2
rationale: The three members share membrane phospholipid signalling: S1P/LPA receptor signalling, phosphatidylinositol synthesis control and VEGFR2 PLC-gamma–PKC proliferation; confusables are coagulation, eicosanoid, endocannabinoid and vitamin K pathways.

name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescence-associated heterochromatin
rationale: Members cover oncogene-induced senescence, SAHF and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation, and regulation of senescence and proliferative arrest; SASP, replicative/oxidative senescence and p53-apoptosis confusables lack the oncogene and heterochromatin members.

name: Methionine synthase-dependent methionine biosynthesis and its defects
rationale: Members are methionine and sulfur/aspartate-family amino acid synthesis and the MTR/MTRR deficiency diseases; cobalamin, SAM/choline and folate confusables lack the methionine synthesis members.

name: CDC42, RHOG and RHOJ GTPase cycles
rationale: All members describe the CDC42-subfamily and RHOG GTPase cycles and their signalling, including G beta-gamma input to CDC42; confusables are RAC, RHOA/B/C or RHOD/U/V cycles.

qualifier: PLC-gamma, GRB7, GAB1 and PI3K effectors
name: EGFR/ERBB2 adaptor signalling via PLC-gamma, GRB7, GAB1 and PI3K
rationale: Members describe effector docking downstream of EGFR and ERBB2 (PLCG1, GRB7, GAB1, PI3K, SHC1/GRB2) and ERBB2-driven motility; confusables centre on ERBB2/ERBB4 SHC1/GRB2 events, ERBB3/ERBB4 and EGFR transactivation.

core: FLT3 mutant tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance
name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of FLT3 mutants
rationale: Every member is FLT3 mutant binding of, or resistance to, a specific tyrosine kinase inhibitor; confusables concern ALK, KIT/PDGFR mutants or FLT3 signalling rather than drug resistance.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and lipid transfer
name: ER tubular network shaping, fusion and lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover ER tubule formation, membrane bending, ER fusion and localisation, ER-plasma membrane tethering and lipid/cholesterol transfer with vesicle traffic; confusables are phosphoinositide synthesis, ER-Golgi PI transfer and mitochondria-ER tethering.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix and collagen receptor signalling
name: Integrin–extracellular matrix adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members are ECM gene modules, integrin cell-surface interactions, fibronectin matrix formation, collagen receptor signalling and cell-matrix adhesion; confusables are EMT/stromal programmes, collagen fibril assembly or MMP-driven collagen degradation.

core: APC/C ubiquitin ligase regulation in mitosis
name: APC/C regulation through Emi1 degradation and mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern control of APC/C activity and its substrate degradation across metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit; Emi1 phosphorylation/SCF degradation and Cdc6 removal are what the Cdc20/Cdh1 switch confusables lack.

name: DNA mismatch repair and its MSH/MLH1 defects
rationale: All members are DNA mismatch repair, including MutSalpha/MutSbeta-directed repair, meiotic MMR and MSH2/3/6 and MLH1 deficiencies; confusables are double-strand break and recombination repair.
